about_item: [Open-Ear Design] Bone conduction headphones, powered by the next-generation bone conduction technology enclosed cavity, deliver premium audio through the cheekbones, providing clear loud sound reproduction even in noisy environments. The open ear headphones allow you to enjoy music without missing the sound of your surroundings, comfortable listening while doing outdoor workouts.

[Bluetooth 6.0 Seamless Pairing] CXK bone conduction earbuds come with the latest version of Bluetooth 6.0 to provide a faster more stable connection. Bone Headphones one-step quickly pairing that Long presses the "MFB" button for 2 seconds to power on. First time use, click "X14" on your mobile device to connect, and effortlessly control your music and calls with easy one-key control.

[Stereo Sound Quality] Bone conduction headphones bluetooth feature large 15mm bone conduction drivers for premium high-quality stereo sound and immersive. It is suitable for all music genres with soft audio, allowing you to enjoy an immersive listening experience. Conduction headphones built-in microphone with wireless bluetooth connectivity provides you with wireless listening and a clear calling experience.
[10Hrs Playtime] Bluetooth headphones provide uninterrupted playback for up to 10 hours on a single charge. The headphones can be fully charged in 2 hours via Type C on standby for up to 240 hours.

[Lightweight & Comfortable] The wireless headphones are engineered with a wrap-around titanium frame, with a feather-light weight of just 28g, and the skin-friendly silicone material is used for the part in contact with the skin which is lightweight and stable, experience optimal comfort during extended use of the conduction headphones and ensure durability and reliability during workouts and outdoor. (Not suitable for swimming)

[AI Music Creator & Custom EQ] Turn your mood, style, or ideas into original tracks with the Boean app. Experiment with genres, beats, and tones, then fine-tune your sound using custom EQ modes—from jazz to classical. Paired with bluetooth earphones, it delivers a revolutionary music experience for everyone, whether you're a music enthusiast just starting out or a professional.

summary.text: Customers find these bone conduction headphones excellent in sound quality, with clear audio and the ability to hear surroundings. Moreover, they receive positive feedback for their quality, value for money, and battery life that lasts a long time. Additionally, customers appreciate their comfort, noting they don't hurt the ears and stay in place during workouts, while the Bluetooth connectivity is praised for being effortless and quick. However, reliability is mixed, with some customers reporting that the left earphone speaker quits working.
